question: where would the SRT adapter's STS head actually place on MTEB
checkpoint: v22c_a050 (soup of v18 + v21a), best of the STS series
metric: cosine_spearman, the metric the MTEB leaderboard ranks on
decision: do not submit. competitive board models sit at 0.80 or better on these tasks and averaged GloVe reaches roughly 0.58 on STSBenchmark, so 0.5192 would enter below a bag-of-words baseline. the adapter's STS head is a 12.7M side-channel on a frozen backbone and was never built to compete with dedicated sentence encoders. the line is closed.
note: the 0.3744 figure quoted elsewhere is a mean over 40 splits under our own harness including multilingual subsets. it is not a leaderboard figure and is not comparable to one.
